# December bake-off: brief and specimen pack (2026-11-07)

## The brief, in Este's words and the calls that follow from them

- **Seasonal, festive.** "We're international, so we just want to make it festive." 171 Store markets.
- **Winding down and getting ready for the new.** The year closing, the next one coming.
- **Celestial.** "Inspired by Cyan Fade, space at the top, earthy at the bottom."

Calls made from that (Claude's, not Este's; he can overrule any):

- Festive means year-end celebration, not Christmas. No trees, Santas, menorahs, lanterns, religious or single-culture symbols.
- No snow and no winter-only imagery: December is summer in Brazil and Australia. The December solstice is the one sky event every market shares (the longest night in the north, the longest day in the south), so it is fair game.
- It must still read as a studio that ships. A good mood, not a costume.
- Brand pair stays: cyan `#17d4fa` and magenta `#f22f89` are present on every sheet, but as light in the sky (stars, aurora, string lights), never as body type unless they clear AA on their ground.

Every sheet renders THIS content and nothing else. The variable across sheets is treatment: type, color, motif, structure. Judge the treatment, not the words.

## 3. Work (render these ten, in this order; the first is the flagship)

- **RoRoRo**: Run multiple Roblox clients side by side, each signed in as a different saved account. Free on the Microsoft Store.
- **Sanduhr für Claude**: Your claude.ai usage meters on the desktop: session and weekly limits with a pace mark and reset times.
- **Celestia 3**: NASA-grade astrology AI.
- **Vibe Cartographer**: Find your direction no matter where you start.
- **Vibe Iterate**: Maintain your Atlas.
- **Vibe Insights**: The /insights you wish you had.
- **Vibe Keystone**: Map the repo before the agent starts.
- **Vibe Doc**: Point it at your codebase and it finds the docs you're missing.
- **Vibe Test**: Put your code to the test before somebody else does.
- **Vibe Thesis**: Long-form research, drafted with discipline.

## 4. The founding (section 02)

- eyebrow: 02 · The founding
- headline: 626Labs builds exact-fit software.
- pull quote (Este's own words; set it in a handwritten-feeling face if the sheet has one, upright, at least 24px): I build tools, because care doesn't always scale.

> 626Labs builds exact-fit software. The founding argument is simple: it has never been easier to have the exact tools we need, and too much money has been going to too many companies for tools that only half fit. So we build and maintain our own, at a quality that rivals enterprise software, made to enhance the work people do instead of taking their jobs. We are here to make great products, even if only a handful of people need them. That's ok.

## Constraints every sheet inherits

- **AA everywhere.** Every text/ground pair at 4.5:1 or better, graded against the tone the text actually sits on. On a gradient, grade against the worst stop under that text. Document every pair with its ratio in the sheet's top comment, the way `themes/cyan-fade/tokens.css` does.
- **Phone first.** It must read well at 390px wide with no horizontal scroll. Este reviews these on his phone.
- **Motion** is ambient and optional: respect `prefers-reduced-motion`, and the page is complete at rest with no motion at all.
- **Generated sky**: draw stars, lights or aurora with canvas or CSS, never long hand-written SVG paths. Seed any randomness so a reload looks the same.
- Brand: "626Labs" with no space, everywhere. Tagline "Imagine Something Else." keeps its period.
- No emoji. Em dashes minimal.
